newsitem.title: NORWAY: DnB attracts buyers, rises 3.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: DnB attracts buyers, rises 3.5 percent.

text.p: Shares in Norway's largest bank, Den norske Bank ASA (DnB), climbed 3.5 percent on Thursday in relatively heavy trade.
Dealers said the move was due to a positive analyst report in London.
At 1232 GMT DnB was one crown up at 29.20 in turnover of 38.6 million crowns. At the same time total turnover on the Oslo bourse amounted to 264 million crowns.
"Apparently there is a buy recommendation out in London and that's why there's so much buying interest," an Oslo based broker said.
DnB's rise also was helping the country's second largest bank, Christiania Bank og Kreditkasse ASA, which advanced 2.85 percent, or 0.70 crowns, to 25.30 crowns.
